notes: Never ran HQ or R&D all game and burned about 12 clicks plus 2 credits each on tag removal (T5-T16) against tags that were never punished, leaving the Runner broke. T15 did not pay 2 to get through Loot Box on Server 6 while holding 3 credits, and T16 (6 credits) did not run Server 6 at all; the Tomorrow's Headline there was scored T17 for the win. Carmen was installed T3 and never used; T7 ran Server 3 into an unrezzed ice with 0 credits.

Against an AU Co. net-damage deck the Runner facechecked HQ T1 (Ivik) and on T4 deliberately ran R&D into the known, unbroken Phoneutria, losing 2 cards each time. T5 facechecked Server 2 with 5 cards, chose to continue through Karuna's jack-out sub down to 1 card, then accessed Urtica Cipher and was flatlined; jacking out was the obvious play.

Digging R&D through Funhouse was reasonable and stole Kingmaking (T3) and Oracle Thinktank (T9), but Nanuq left the game on the first steal and the Runner never drew to find another breaker. About 14 clicks at 2 credits each went to removing tags that Funhouse gave right back. Facechecked Server 3 (T7) and Server 4 (T8) with 1 credit, then sat passive from T10 to T14 clicking credits and removing tags while the Corp scored 3 agendas and won with Backroom Machinations.

Solid aggressive game: Rising Tide broke Ivik and Hafrun, it stole from R&D, Archives and Server 2, and won T9. Minor issues: T4 facechecked Server 2 with 0 credits (Hafrun ended the run), and T6/T7 clicked for credits instead of pressuring the advanced Server 1.

Ran into the known Piranhas on HQ or R&D about 13 times (T1-T12) with no way to break it, taking 1 net damage and an end-the-run every time and losing Jailbreak, Tremolo, Carmen and Sure Gamble. Afterimage (installed T6) was never used against it. The remote that scored 4 agendas (T6, T10, T12, T13) was attacked only once (T4).

Ran an unchanged R&D four times a turn (T1, T2, T4, T6), seeing the same top card again and again, then clicked for credits up to 27 (T5, T7, T8) without installing anything. Never ran Server 1, which had a single ice and scored agendas installed on T3, T5 and T7; each could have been stolen the turn it went down.

Gauss on R&D/HQ produced a reasonable early lead (6 points by T8), but the Runner ended T4 tagged with 7 credits and lost Daily Casts T5. It facechecked Server 1 with 3 credits T12, then on T13 and T19 re-ran into the known F2P that bounces Gauss. The economy collapsed for a long stretch (T12-T20) before Into the Depths on R&D found the last point on T21.

Clicked for credits nearly every turn from T3 to T17, reaching 69 credits with 5 unplayed cards, and never installed a breaker or ran HQ or R&D. It also left two Daily Quests (Server 1/2) untrashed. Its only runs (T12 Server 3, T13 Server 4) bounced off ETR ice it had no way to break, and the Corp scored out behind them.

Spent T1-T4 and most later turns (T7, T10-T16) clicking credits up to 48 with a full grip, and never installed a program or ran HQ or R&D. It left Server 2 (naked T2-T13) and Server 4 (naked T6-T14) unchecked and never trashed Bladderwort, while Personal Evolution scored 4 agendas out of Server 5/6.

Good start (Chastushka T2, steals from Archives, R&D and HQ, 5 points), but on T11 and T12 it ran R&D into the known Bathynomus (3 net damage) and dropped to 1 card against Personal Evolution. On T12 Mitosis had just put two naked 2-advanced cards in Servers 4/5; a steal there would have won, but instead the Runner took Bathynomus damage and was flatlined by the See How They Run score from Server 5.

Competent pressure game: checked naked remotes early and stole the Mitosis'd Lotus Haze (T3), then Chastushka plus Archives took two agendas (T6), and Abaasy through Hafrun found the winning steal on T11. The only oddity is that the T8 Server 5 run with 3 cards hit Urtica, which was a reasonable risk.

Good R&D pressure through Funhouse and paid through Grubber to steal from the remote, winning T9. Mistakes: T1 installed Daily Casts while tagged from F2P, so it was trashed T2, and T7 ran Server 1 into the known Grubber (2 x pay 3) with only 3 credits, wasting the click and the credits.

Clicked credits T2-T7 up to 24 without running, leaving naked Server 1 (T3) and Server 3 (T5) unchecked. T17-T18 drew 7 cards into a core-damaged hand and discarded 6 of them. The win came late, from Finality on R&D (T14, T16) and a T19 remote steal, after the Corp had been allowed 2 free Hybrid Release scores.

Reached 6 points by T3, then clicked credits for most of T4-T17 up to 48 instead of running for the last point. On T11 it twice declined to pay 2 credits to Loot Box on Archives while holding 38, and it ignored the card installed in Server 2 behind unrezzed Congratulations!, which scored as Tomorrow's Headline T12 and would have been the winning steal. It finally won T18 by running that same server.

Good early steals (HQ T1, Server 1 through Loot Box T3) and steady R&D pressure through Congratulations! won the race on T14. Debbie was installed tagged T3 and Daily Casts with 3 tags on T10, and both were trashed. T11's Window of Opportunity was wasted on a 1-credit ice. T12 ran HQ into the known Doomscroll with 2+ tags and no credits for Carmen, losing 3 cards. The Server 2 scoring remote was left uncontested from T7 to T11.

T1-T4 spent every click re-running an unchanged R&D (4 runs a turn), then T6-T15 clicked credits up to 44 without installing anything. It never ran Server 2, which had one ice and scored agendas on T3, T10, T14 and T16; the T9 and T15 installs there could have been stolen the next turn.

Repeatedly failed to pay the 1 credit that Paywall asks for on R&D when it could afford it (T8, T12, T16 second run), and ran Paywall with too little money on T5 and T7. T9 paid Grubber's first 3 but not the second 3 while holding 4, so the Remastered Edition scored T10 got away. T6 ran into Grubber with only 4 credits, and T15 SMC fetched a redundant second Gauss.

Good start (multi-access HQ, stole Sericulture Expansion from Server 3 on T4), but from T5 to T14 it clicked for credits every turn up to 45 with Odore installed. Meanwhile the Corp scored from Server 2 (installed T12, scored T13) and from the Hybrid Release install on naked Server 4 (T10), all unchallenged. Its first run after that was T15 into Tatu-Bola.

Sensible game: used The Price to get Rising Tide and Utae, broke Hafrun on R&D every turn and stole from Server 1 twice, winning T17. Weaknesses: it sat on a tag from T11 to T16 and re-installed Fencer Fueno (T14) only to have it trashed, and it never pressured the 3-advanced Server 2.

Stole Artificial Cryptocrash on T4, but Nanuq left the game, and from T8 to T24 the Runner clicked credits every turn up to 69 with 5 cards in hand. It never drew for a breaker, installed nothing, never trashed the Daily Quests (it declined to trash one on T7 with 12 credits), and never ran centrals. The Corp scored 4 agendas behind single Klevetniks in Servers 4/5.
